name: Track Temu product prices with Apify and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Track Temu product prices in Google Sheets

Keep a small watchlist of exact Temu products in your own spreadsheet. This workflow is for people who already know which products they want to follow and want current source-reported prices together with factual changes. It does not recommend deals or predict demand.

### How it works
A manual trigger validates one to five goods IDs, the market, a stable monitoring scope and a charge cap. The workflow starts the pinned Apify Actor once and waits for that same run. It checks the authoritative output, coverage, row count and estimated Actor event cost before writing anything. The first trustworthy run creates a baseline. Later runs report changes or unchanged snapshots. A stable key updates the same Sheet row for the same product and scope. Incomplete checks stop with an error rather than claiming that a product disappeared. This sheet is a current register, not a permanent history of every change.

### Setup
1. Create an Apify Header Auth credential: name Authorization, value Bearer followed by your API token. Select it on all four HTTP Request nodes.
2. Connect a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential on the Sheets node.
3. Create a Temu Watch tab using the supplied header CSV.
4. Set your goods IDs, spreadsheet ID and market in Product watch settings. Keep the scope name stable and run sequentially.
5. Start manually with one product and a small charge cap. Inspect the output and Sheet before repeating. Apify usage is paid; the template does not include credits.

## 1. Configure
Set your product IDs and Sheet destination. Validation stops placeholders and invalid caps before paid work.

## 2. Run once and wait
Only the first HTTP call starts an Actor. Polling reads the existing run; failures stop before any Sheet write.

## 3. Verify output
Read the authoritative summary and the complete bounded dataset. Reject incomplete coverage or row-count mismatches.

## 4. Update your register
One stable key per product and search scope. Only destination delivery may retry; the paid Actor never retries automatically.
